name: Matrix
label: Matrix — Matrix Client-Server API v1.19
description: Matrix via the official Matrix Client-Server API v1.19. Base https://. Docs: https://spec.matrix.org/v1.19/client-server-api/. Endpoint paths remain /_matrix/client/v3 (spec version ≠ HTTP path version). E2EE rooms are out of v1 (plaintext only). homeserver is interpolated into the path (baseUrl https://). listen = /sync is not opened here — use a BPMN message event for appservice/webhook bridges. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Matrix operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"get-account"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: get-account | get-event | send-message | list-messages | send-media | create-room | invite-room | join-room | kick-room | leave-room | list-members | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: roomId
schema.description: Room id !opaque:server for send-message, list-messages, get-event, invite/kick/leave/list-members. Example: !abc:matrix.org.

schema.label: eventId
schema.description: Event id for get-event. Example: $abc.

schema.label: txnId
schema.description: Transaction id path for send-message (client-generated unique). Example: txn-172.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Message body for send-message. Official body.

schema.label: msgtype
schema.description: Message type for send-message. EXACT typical: m.text | m.notice | m.emote. Example: m.text.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: Matrix user id for invite-room / kick-room. Example: @bob:matrix.org.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Pagination token for list-messages.

schema.label: dir
schema.description: Pagination direction, required by list-messages (query `dir`). EXACT: b (backwards, newest first) | f (forwards). Example: b.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: list-messages page size. Example: 30.

schema.label: filename
schema.description: filename query for send-media. Example: photo.jpg.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Room name for create-room.

schema.label: topic
schema.description: Room topic for create-room.

schema.label: preset
schema.description: create-room preset. EXACT: private_chat | public_chat | trusted_private_chat.

schema.label: invite
schema.description: User ids to invite on create-room. Example: ["@ada:matrix.org"].

schema.label: roomIdOrAlias
schema.description: Room id or #alias:server for join-room.

schema.label: reason
schema.description: Kick reason for kick-room.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: get-account, get-event, send-message, list-messages, send-media, create-room, invite-room, join-room, kick-room, leave-room, list-members, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Matrix access token. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: homeserver
configurationParameters.description: Homeserver host only (no scheme), e.g. matrix.example.com. Path prefix.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
